ARDOT repeats the current draft’s claim that the Ouachitas are the only U.S. range oriented east-west. The cache supplies no underlying geographical record to check that sweeping claim; omitted rather than repeated.
Grand Canyon of the Ozarks moment is short because the cache supports a vista and road character, but no detailed geology or managed overlook access.
Northbound moment order follows decreasing strip miles: Hot Springs 182.85, vista south of Jasper 43.79, Harrison 23.56. Catalog mapping beyond Harrison is not treated as designated byway.
